description: Sensitive data (raw records) is transmitted over an encrypted channel, but if the encryption is compromised or the data is intercepted, it can be read by unauthorized parties.
mitigation: Use secure encryption protocols and ensure the encryption keys are properly managed and rotated.

description: Sensitive data in the Raw Data Bucket is exposed to unauthorized users due to lack of encryption at rest.

description: Sensitive data in the Raw Data Bucket is exposed to unauthorized users due to lack of versioning and write controls.

description: The external data producer is internet-exposed and accepts requests without rate limits or quotas, making it susceptible to being overwhelmed and denying service to legitimate users.

description: Sensitive data may be exposed if the HTTPS connection is compromised or if the data is misrouted to an unauthorized party.

description: Sensitive data in the Raw Data Bucket is exposed to unauthorized users due to public access.
